cloze-hint: Select the words to hide and press Add deletion. Written out, a deletion is {{syntax}}.
error-back-required: Add the back of the card
error-cloze-empty: A deletion has no answer in it
error-cloze-nested: A deletion cannot contain another deletion
error-cloze-no-deletions: Add at least one deletion: select a word and press Add deletion
error-cloze-too-many-indices: A cloze card can use at most 20 different deletion numbers
error-cloze-unterminated: A deletion is missing its closing braces
error-front-required: Add the front of the card
import-types-hint: A third column reading reverse makes a reversible card. A front with {{syntax}} makes a cloze card.
reason-invalid-cloze: The cloze text has a broken, nested or missing deletion
reversible-hint: A second card is added with the sides swapped, so you study it both ways.
